title: Tool-Check Plus
description: A compact collection of driver bits, sockets and a small ratchet. Explore how the individual tools fit together in their holder, then turn the model to see the assembly from another angle.

title: Joker Wrench
description: The Joker combines a distinctive open-end head with a slim metal body. The supplied photographs show the wrench in use; the interactive model makes its shape and head geometry easy to inspect.

title: Kraftform XXL
description: A collection of Kraftform screwdrivers with recognisable green and black handles. Compare the handles, shafts and tips in the product view and photograph.
features: Several tool profiles in one collection

title: Kraftform Phillips Screwdriver
description: A Phillips screwdriver with Wera's sculpted Kraftform handle. Its simple outline makes the contrast between the soft grip, hard handle zones and metal shaft especially clear in the spatial view.

title: Kraftform Kompakt
description: A compact tool collection organised around a Kraftform handle and interchangeable tooling. Rotate the complete assembly to explore its layout and compare it with the supplied product photograph.

title: Kraftform Kompakt 20
description: Kraftform Kompakt 20 brings a bit holder and stored bits together in a compact handle. The supplied images show both the assembled tool and its opening and interchangeable components.

title: Hex-Plus L-Keys
description: A set of brightly coloured L-keys arranged in a compact clip. The different lengths and colour coding remain readable in both the category view and the detailed model.

title: Zyklop Speed
description: A ratchet with the characteristic Kraftform handle and swivelling head. Use the product views and supplied video to explore the relationship between its grip, shaft and ratchet mechanism.

title: Chronograph
description: A Rolex watch model with a detailed dial, metal bracelet and reflective surfaces. It brings the interplay of glass, polished metal and small-scale detail into a complete product-page composition.

title: Brio 500
description: Brio 500 is a Full HD webcam with automatic light correction and a Show Mode for presenting objects on a desk. Its cylindrical housing and monitor mount make a useful study in product proportions and material contrast.

title: ERGO K860
description: ERGO K860 combines a curved, split keyboard with an integrated wrist rest. The supplied model and photographs show the graphite keyboard and its German key layout from several angles.

title: Signature Plus M750 L
description: The larger Signature Plus M750 pairs a contoured mouse body with SmartWheel scrolling and wireless connectivity. Close views reveal the wheel, side buttons, textured grips and underside of the graphite model.

title: Z407 Speakers
description: The Z407 speaker system brings together two satellite speakers, a subwoofer and a wireless control dial. The spatial model makes the separate components and their arrangement easy to understand.

title: Profile 8 40 × 40 Light
description: A short sample of item Profile 8 40 × 40 light, identified in the source model as article 0.0.026.33. Its anodised aluminium cross-section has four open Line 8 grooves. Rotate it to compare the exterior surfaces with the internal profile geometry.

title: Standard-Fastening Set 8
description: The source model identifies this connector as item Standard-Fastening Set 8, article 0.0.026.07. The set combines a zinc-plated connecting plate and an M8 screw for joining Line 8 profiles. The spatial view reveals the plate, screw head and thread together.

title: Profile End Cap
description: An end-cap example from the supplied item collection. Its compact form complements the profile and connector examples, showing how small components can be presented alongside larger assemblies.

title: Collision Guard L
description: The supplied model depicts item Collision Guard L with hazard markings, article 0.0.665.48. Its yellow and black surface and L-shaped steel body make the product recognisable at a glance. Turn it around to inspect its shape and floor mounting points.

title: Robot Assembly
description: The supplied Robby model turns geometric components into a playful robot figure. Explore its head, arms, torso and legs from different angles. It is a visual assembly study rather than an orderable industrial robot configuration.
